title: ID0455452-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP/R8 170002538] Charging issue
description:
Reported behavior/issue- Charging issue
Solution: we informed the customer that the external l
oad management can't be configured on charger and not used. In Firmware version 8 this set the outlets out of order.
We removed this configuration and the outlets are available again.

additional_info.subject: ID0455452-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP/R8 170002538] Charging issue CRM:02889000730
additional_info.body:
Dear Marcel,
thank you for contacting our eMobility Support.
The External Load Management can't be configured on charger and not used. In Firmware version 8 this set the outlets out of order.
We remove this configuration and the outlets are available again.
Thank you for your attention.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Philippe Ribeiro
